a.lede: A power bank is more than its capacity. You also need to know how fast it can deliver power so your laptop doesn't drain while it's connected.
a.title: How powerful of a power bank do you need to safely charge a laptop?

b.lede: We tested 13 power banks from Anker, Belkin, Baseus, Cuktech, and Sharge, tracking charge times, output, temps, and capacity to see which actually hold up.
b.title: We tested 13 power banks to help you choose the best one
